claims.evidence: The year is not clearly legible on the engine cover in photo 0.

risks.risk: The engine may be seized, stripped, or have internal mechanical failure.
risks.proof: A video showing the engine being started and running.

risks.risk: The transmission may be missing, damaged, or incompatible with the engine.
risks.proof: A photo of the transmission mounted separately from the engine.

risks.risk: The engine may be a different model (e.g., 4.0L or 5.0L) than the seller claims.
risks.proof: A clear photo of the engine identification plate (usually on the engine cover).

proof_requests: Close-up of any label, sticker or metal plate showing the brand and model.
Photo of the engine identification plate showing the model and year.
Photo of the transmission mounted separately from the engine.
Video of the engine running or being tested.
response.reason: The item is known from the photos. What they cannot prove is priced at its worst case until the proof asked for below arrives.
